units.source_text: 这是一个温气大的夜晚。
天空飘浮着一层薄云，月色朦胧。

en.t: A thin veil of clouds drifted across the sky, and the moonlight was hazy.

units.source_text: 我穿着草黄色裤子，披着工作服，脚上蹬着木屣。

en.t: I was wearing grass-yellow trousers, had a work jacket thrown over my shoulders, and wooden clogs on my feet.

units.source_text: 大概数小时后，我还会以同样的装束折回来的吧。

en.t: In a few hours, I would probably come back in the same outfit.

units.source_text: 但我怎样才能说服自己接受以这种装来变成另一个人的预想呢？

en.t: But how could I persuade myself to accept the prospect of becoming another person in this outfit?
